mandatory_submission_requirements.quote:
C. MANDATORY SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS 
Each Proposal must also consist of the following components: 
1. The Proposal must be received by the Submission Deadline indicated in 1.4 RFP 
Timetable and must be submitted using the submission method set out in 1.5 
Submission of Proposals. 
2. The Proposal must be in English. 
3. A completed Submission Form in PDF format which is signed by an authorized 
representative of the proponent described in Appendix C. 
4. A completed Narrative Response in PDF format which follows the table contents in 
Appendix B – Section A. 
5. A completed Pricing Excel Workbook described in Appendix B – Section G.  Template 
for workbook provided. 
6. A completed Requirements Excel Workbook.  Instructions are in the provided 
requirements workbook.

mandatory_technical_requirements.quote:
D. MANDATORY TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS 
The following sets out the mandatory technical requirements of the proponent and the proposed 
solution: 
1. Support for organizations operating in Canada including support for Canadian taxes and 
Canadian Payroll. 
2. Vendor has experience implementing solutions for First Nations in Canada. 
3. The solution must be hosted in Canada and stores all data within Canada. 
4. Implementation vendor(s) can demonstrate they have at least five years' experience 
implementing Finance, HR, Payroll, and Asset Management solutions. 
5. Solution is cloud based. 
6. The solutions are SOC2 Type 2 compliant or equivalent.   
Failure to meet the mandatory technical will result in disqualification from consideration.
value: Support for organizations operating in Canada including support for Canadian taxes and Canadian Payroll.
Vendor has experience implementing solutions for First Nations in Canada.
The solution must be hosted in Canada and stores all data within Canada.
Implementation vendor(s) can demonstrate they have at least five years' experience implementing Finance, HR, Payroll, and Asset Management solutions.
The solutions are SOC2 Type 2 compliant or equivalent.

pricing_structure.quote: Proponents should submit their pricing information by completing the attached Pricing Sheet and including it in their proposals.  This includes details for implementing and supporting the solution over a 5-year period.
pricing_structure.value: Pricing must be submitted on the attached Pricing Sheet (Excel workbook) included in the proposal, covering implementation and support over a 5-year period. Rates must be in Canadian funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes, and all-inclusive of all labour, material, travel, insurance, delivery, installation, set-up, and overhead costs.
